mapper.sql: FROM expert_user eu JOIN user u ON u.member_id = eu.member_id

sql.where:
AND u.member_type = '전문가회원'
AND eu.approve_status = #{approveStatus}
AND u.member_status = #{memberStatus}
AND eu.is_online = 1
AND (eu.is_online = 0 OR eu.is_online IS NULL)
AND CAST(eu.member_id AS CHAR) LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%')
AND u.login_id LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%')
AND u.user_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%')
AND eu.specialty LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%')
AND ( CAST(eu.member_id AS CHAR) LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR u.login_id LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR u.user_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR eu.specialty LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') )

mapper.select:
SELECT COUNT(*) AS totalCount, SUM(CASE WHEN DATE(u.created_date) = CURDATE() THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS todayAppliedCount, SUM(CASE WHEN eu.approve_status = 1 AND DATE(eu.approved_date) = CURDATE() THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS todayApprovedCount, SUM(CASE WHEN eu.approve_status = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS waitingCount, SUM(CASE WHEN eu.approve_status = 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS rejectedCount
WHERE u.member_type = '전문가회원'

SELECT eu.member_id AS memberId, u.login_id AS loginId, u.user_name AS userName, u.email AS email, u.phone AS phone, u.created_date AS createdDate, u.member_status AS memberStatus, u.status_reason AS statusReason,
eu.specialty AS specialty, eu.expert_introduce AS expertIntroduce, eu.is_online AS isOnline, eu.approve_status AS approveStatus, eu.approved_date AS approvedDate, eu.profile_image_path AS profileImagePath
ORDER BY CASE WHEN eu.approve_status = 0 THEN 0 ELSE 1 END, u.created_date DESC, eu.member_id DESC
LIMIT #{size} OFFSET #{offset}

SELECT eu.member_id AS memberId, u.login_id AS loginId, u.user_name AS userName, u.nickname AS nickname, u.email AS email, u.phone AS phone, u.gender AS gender, u.birth_date AS birthDate, u.zipcode AS zipcode, u.address AS address, u.address2 AS address2, u.member_type AS memberType, u.member_status AS memberStatus, u.status_reason AS statusReason, u.created_date AS createdDate, u.updated_date AS updatedDate, u.last_login_date AS lastLoginDate,
eu.specialty AS specialty, eu.expert_introduce AS expertIntroduce, eu.is_online AS isOnline, eu.approve_status AS approveStatus, eu.approved_date AS approvedDate, eu.profile_image_path AS profileImagePath FROM expert_user eu JOIN user u ON u.member_id = eu.member_id WHERE eu.member_id = #{memberId}
mapper.update: UPDATE user SET status_reason = #{reason}, updated_date = NOW() WHERE member_id = #{memberId}
mapper.select:
SELECT eu.member_id AS memberId, u.login_id AS loginId, u.user_name AS userName, u.email AS email, u.created_date AS createdDate, u.member_status AS memberStatus,
eu.specialty AS specialty, eu.expert_introduce AS expertIntroduce, eu.is_online AS isOnline, eu.approve_status AS approveStatus, eu.approved_date AS approvedDate, eu.profile_image_path AS profileImagePath,
COUNT(c.consult_id) AS totalConsultCount, IFNULL(SUM(TIMESTAMPDIFF(MINUTE, c.consult_start_date, c.consult_end_date)), 0) AS totalMinutes,
IFNULL(rv.avgRating, 0) AS avgRating, IFNULL(rv.reviewCount, 0) AS reviewCount
FROM expert_user eu JOIN user u ON u.member_id = eu.member_id
LEFT JOIN consultation c ON c.expert_id = eu.member_id
LEFT JOIN ( SELECT cs.expert_id, ROUND(COALESCE(AVG(cr.consult_like_level), 0), 1) AS avgRating, COUNT(cr.review_id) AS reviewCount FROM consultation cs LEFT JOIN consult_review cr ON cr.consult_id = cs.consult_id GROUP BY cs.expert_id ) rv ON rv.expert_id = eu.member_id
eu.approve_status = #{status}
AND ( u.user_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR u.login_id LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR u.email LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR eu.specialty LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') )
GROUP BY eu.member_id, u.login_id, u.user_name, u.email, u.created_date, u.member_status, eu.specialty, eu.expert_introduce, eu.is_online, eu.approve_status, eu.approved_date, eu.profile_image_path, rv.avgRating, rv.reviewCount
HAVING COUNT(c.consult_id) >= #{minConsult}
ORDER BY
totalConsultCount DESC, eu.member_id DESC
totalConsultCount ASC, eu.member_id DESC
totalMinutes DESC, eu.member_id DESC
totalMinutes ASC, eu.member_id DESC
avgRating DESC, reviewCount DESC, eu.member_id DESC
avgRating ASC, reviewCount ASC, eu.member_id DESC
eu.approved_date DESC, eu.member_id DESC
u.created_date DESC, eu.member_id DESC

SELECT u.member_id AS memberId, u.login_id AS loginId, u.user_name AS userName, u.nickname AS nickname, u.birth_date AS birthDate, u.gender AS gender, u.phone AS phone, u.email AS email, u.zipcode AS zipcode, u.address AS address, u.address2 AS address2, u.member_status AS memberStatus, u.status_reason AS statusReason, u.member_type AS memberType, u.created_date AS createdDate, u.updated_date AS updatedDate, u.last_login_date AS lastLoginDate FROM user u WHERE u.member_id = #{memberId}
SELECT organization, career_year, career_month, medical_departments, is_employed FROM expert_career WHERE expert_id = #{memberId} ORDER BY career_year DESC, career_month DESC
SELECT expert_school, expert_major, degree_name, graduation_yn FROM expert_career2 WHERE expert_id = #{memberId}
SELECT bank_name, acct_no FROM expert_settlement WHERE member_id = #{memberId}

SELECT DATE_FORMAT(c.consult_end_date, '%Y-%m') AS settlementMonth, eu.member_id AS expertId, u.user_name AS expertName,
COUNT(c.consult_id) AS consCnt,
CAST(SUM( CASE WHEN c.consult_type = '채팅' THEN 5000 WHEN c.consult_type = '전화' THEN 5000 WHEN c.consult_type = '1:1문의' THEN 2000 ELSE 0 END ) AS DECIMAL(15,2)) AS currAmt,
CAST(SUM( CASE WHEN c.consult_type = '채팅' THEN 5000 WHEN c.consult_type = '전화' THEN 5000 WHEN c.consult_type = '1:1문의' THEN 2000 ELSE 0 END ) AS DECIMAL(15,2)) AS totAmt,
CAST(0 AS DECIMAL(15,2)) AS paidAmt,
IFNULL(es.settlement_status, '대기') AS status, es.settlement_date AS settlementDate, es.bank_name AS bankName, es.acct_no AS acctNo
FROM expert_user eu JOIN user u ON u.member_id = eu.member_id
LEFT JOIN consultation c ON c.expert_id = eu.member_id AND c.status = 3
AND DATE_FORMAT(c.consult_end_date, '%Y-%m') = #{month}
LEFT JOIN expert_settlement es ON es.member_id = eu.member_id
AND es.settlement_month = #{month}
GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(c.consult_end_date, '%Y-%m'), eu.member_id, u.user_name, es.settlement_status, es.settlement_date, es.bank_name, es.acct_no
ORDER BY settlementMonth DESC, eu.member_id DESC

SELECT c.consult_id AS consultId, c.expert_id AS expertId, m.user_name AS memberName, c.consult_type AS consultType, c.consult_start_date AS consultStartDate, c.consult_end_date AS consultEndDate, CAST( CASE WHEN c.consult_type = '채팅' THEN 5000 WHEN c.consult_type = '전화' THEN 5000 WHEN c.consult_type = '1:1문의' THEN 2000 ELSE 0 END AS DECIMAL(15,2)) AS amount FROM consultation c JOIN user m ON m.member_id = c.member_id WHERE c.expert_id = #{expertId} AND c.status = 3 AND DATE_FORMAT(c.consult_end_date, '%Y-%m') = #{month} ORDER BY c.consult_end_date DESC

SELECT c.expert_id AS expertId, u.user_name AS expertName,
COUNT(c.consult_id) AS consCnt,
CAST(SUM( CASE WHEN c.consult_type = '채팅' THEN 5000 WHEN c.consult_type = '전화' THEN 5000 WHEN c.consult_type = '1:1문의' THEN 2000 ELSE 0 END ) AS DECIMAL(15,2)) AS currAmt,
CAST(SUM( CASE WHEN c.consult_type = '채팅' THEN 5000 WHEN c.consult_type = '전화' THEN 5000 WHEN c.consult_type = '1:1문의' THEN 2000 ELSE 0 END ) AS DECIMAL(15,2)) AS totAmt,
CAST(0 AS DECIMAL(15,2)) AS paidAmt,
es.bank_name AS bankName, es.acct_no AS acctNo,
MIN(DATE(c.consult_start_date)) AS startDt, MAX(DATE(c.consult_end_date)) AS endDt
FROM consultation c JOIN user u ON u.member_id = c.expert_id LEFT JOIN expert_settlement es ON es.member_id = c.expert_id
WHERE c.status = 3 AND c.expert_id = #{expertId} AND DATE_FORMAT(c.consult_end_date, '%Y-%m') = #{month}
GROUP BY c.expert_id, u.user_name, es.bank_name, es.acct_no

SELECT eu.member_id AS memberId, u.login_id AS loginId, u.user_name AS userName, u.email AS email, eu.specialty AS specialty, eu.expert_introduce AS expertIntroduce, eu.is_online AS isOnline, eu.approve_status AS approveStatus, eu.approved_date AS approvedDate, eu.profile_image_path AS profileImagePath FROM expert_user eu JOIN user u ON u.member_id = eu.member_id WHERE eu.member_id = #{memberId}
mapper.update: UPDATE expert_user SET approve_status = #{status}, approved_date = CASE WHEN #{status} = 1 THEN NOW() ELSE NULL END WHERE member_id = #{memberId}
mapper.select: SELECT certification_id AS certificationId, member_id AS memberId, cert_name AS certName, issuer AS issuer, cert_no AS certNo, issued_date AS issuedDate, expired_date AS expiredDate, cert_file_path AS certFilePath, verify_status AS verifyStatus, reject_reason AS rejectReason, created_date AS createdDate FROM certification WHERE member_id = #{memberId} ORDER BY created_date DESC

SELECT certification_id AS certificationId, member_id AS memberId, cert_name AS certName, issuer AS issuer, cert_no AS certNo, issued_date AS issuedDate, expired_date AS expiredDate, cert_file_path AS certFilePath, verify_status AS verifyStatus, reject_reason AS rejectReason, created_date AS createdDate FROM certification WHERE certification_id = #{certId}

SELECT COUNT(*) AS totalConsultCount, COUNT(DISTINCT member_id) AS totalClientCount, IFNULL(SUM(TIMESTAMPDIFF(MINUTE, consult_start_date, consult_end_date)), 0) AS totalMinutes FROM consultation WHERE expert_id = #{memberId}

SELECT c.consult_id AS consultId, c.consult_start_date AS consultStartDate, c.consult_end_date AS consultEndDate, c.consult_type AS consultType, c.status AS status,
u.member_id AS memberId, u.login_id AS clientLoginId, u.user_name AS clientName, u.email AS clientEmail,
IFNULL(TIMESTAMPDIFF(MINUTE, c.consult_start_date, c.consult_end_date), 0) AS minutes FROM consultation c JOIN user u ON u.member_id = c.member_id WHERE c.expert_id = #{memberId} ORDER BY c.consult_start_date DESC

SELECT u.member_id AS memberId, u.login_id AS clientLoginId, u.user_name AS clientName, u.email AS clientEmail,
COUNT(*) AS consultCount, IFNULL(SUM(TIMESTAMPDIFF(MINUTE, c.consult_start_date, c.consult_end_date)), 0) AS totalMinutes, MAX(c.consult_start_date) AS lastConsultAt FROM consultation c JOIN user u ON u.member_id = c.member_id WHERE c.expert_id = #{memberId} GROUP BY u.member_id, u.login_id, u.user_name, u.email ORDER BY consultCount DESC, totalMinutes DESC
mapper.update: UPDATE user SET member_status = #{memberStatus}, status_reason = #{reason}, updated_date = NOW() WHERE member_id = #{memberId}
